items.title: The Agentic Analytics Benchmark, round two: GPT-6, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary: We added GPT-6 Astra, Luna and Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 to the Agentic Analytics Benchmark: all five land mid-board within a point of each other, and Sonnet 5.5 brings the biggest change in turns, cost and truncated runs.
